notes: «- هو ابن أبي عائشة -» is an editor's gloss: «موسى» is written as it stands

Ghaylan's «قال خرجت مع أبي قلابة» is a first-person narrative; Abu Qilaba's «فقال إن رسول الله» relays the Prophet's words, so he is the last link. The rules do not settle the implicit step from Ghaylan's own journey (rule 11)
